interests.title: Your interests
interests.description: Topics you care about, in plain English. Each agenda item is scored against every interest, e.g. "Bike lanes and street safety" or "New apartments near campus".
prefill: Bike lanes, traffic safety and street design
Housing affordability and new apartments near UC Berkeley

jurisdictions.title: Jurisdictions
jurisdictions.description: Which city councils to watch. Berkeley uses its own eAgenda pages; the others are read from the Legistar Web API.

extraLegistarClients.title: Other Legistar jurisdictions
extraLegistarClients.description: Any other Legistar client slug, the part before .legistar.com (for example "seattle" or "chicago"). Hundreds of US cities, counties and agencies publish on Legistar.

daysAhead.title: Days ahead
daysAhead.description: How many days of upcoming meetings to scan.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Also include meetings from this many past days, for catching up on recent decisions.

maxMeetingsPerJurisdiction.title: Max meetings per jurisdiction
maxMeetingsPerJurisdiction.description: Upper bound on meetings read per jurisdiction, which caps run time and cost.

minRelevance.title: Minimum relevance
minRelevance.description: Only items scoring at or above this relevance (0 to 1) are returned as matches. 0.5 keeps items with a real, if indirect, effect on an interest.

includeAllItems.title: Include non-matching items
includeAllItems.description: Also write the items below the relevance threshold to the dataset (not charged as matches).

alertEmail.title: Email alerts to
alertEmail.description: If set, matches are emailed here through the apify/send-mail Actor. Pair with a Schedule to get a weekly digest.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropicApiKey.description: Use your own Anthropic key for Claude scoring. Without a key the Actor uses its configured key, or falls back to keyword matching.
